title: Rubber compounds and vehicle tires
abstract: The present invention relates to a sulfur-crosslinkable rubber compound, particularly for treads for vehicle tires, and a vehicle tire. The rubber mixture comprises: - at least one diene rubber and - at least one silicic acid and - at least one hydrocarbon resin, and - from 1 to 40 phr of at least one liquid polybutadiene, the end groups of which are silicone modified , and it has a weight average molar mass Mw according to GPC from 500 to 12000 g/mol.
